idea-plugin.name: Dumpie
idea-plugin.description:
PHP debug output right inside the IDE. dump(), dd(), log records, SQL queries, exceptions and ray() calls appear in a tool window next to your code, with a link to the line that produced them.

What it catches

  • dump() and dd() from any project with symfony/var-dumper (Laravel, Symfony, …): add VAR_DUMPER_FORMAT=server to .env, or press Add to .env in the settings.
  • Log files: new records from storage/logs or var/log, colored by level, with the stack trace.
  • spatie/ray and spatie/laravel-ray work without any changes: tables, queries, events, jobs, mails, models, exceptions, measurements, pause(), colors, labels and screens.

Built for reading

  • Interactive dumps colored with your editor scheme; light and dark themes follow the IDE.
  • Exceptions with the code around the failing line and folded vendor frames.
  • Filter by color, search, pause the feed, collapse entries.
  • Copy any entry as a Markdown code block that keeps highlighting in chats and issues.
  • One session per project, a switcher between projects and an All projects feed.
  • Several IDEs at once: with PhpStorm and WebStorm open together, output reaches the IDE that has the project open.
  • When a project cannot send anything yet, the empty tool window shows what is missing, with an Add to .env button.
  • Docker and Sail paths are matched to project files automatically.

The project is inspected on first open: Dumpie reads composer.lock, .env and the log directories and enables what fits. Everything is adjustable in Settings | Tools | Dumpie. Dumpie listens on 127.0.0.1 only; nothing leaves your machine.

Dumpie is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Spatie. Ray and spatie/ray are products of Spatie.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • First release: dump()/dd() via VarDumper server mode, log file following, spatie/ray compatibility.
  • Per-project sessions with an All projects feed, color filters, search, pause, copy as Markdown.
  • Settings page with project auto-detection and setup hints in the empty tool window.
  • Output is routed between several IDEs running Dumpie at the same time.
